text.p: Terex Corp said Tuesday it has completed the purchase of Baraga Products Inc, the manufacturer of the Square Shooter, for undisclosed terms.
The Square Shooter is a rough terrain telescopic lift truck designed to move materials to heights where they are used in construction.
Chief executive Ronald M. DeFeo said, "We see this acquisition as having the capability of being meaningful to Terex's bottom line in the future, as well as an immediate positive contributor.

"We also see the opportunity to rapidly increase Baraga's revenues through access to Terex's broad crane and construction distribution networks which now includes the Simon Aerials distribution network.
"To date, the Square Shooter has had very limited distribution," DeFeo explained.
